    print('\\nCASE', val)
    for x in labels[:20]: print(' ', x)

files={'animals':'galaxy_outputs/22_f9cad7b01a47213541ecda8c11df041a.txt','fungi':'galaxy_outputs/25_f9cad7b01a472135a60aac754f543516.txt'}

    vals[group]=[float(r['value']) for r in rows]
    print(group, len(vals[group]), statistics.median(vals[group]))
fold=statistics.median(vals['fungi'])/statistics.median(vals['animals'])
print('fungi/animals', fold)
os.makedirs('codex_output', exist_ok=True)
with open('codex_output/answer.txt','w') as out:
    out.write(f'{fold:.12g}\\n')
print(open('codex_output/answer.txt').read(), end='')
